title: Self Dividing Numbers
statement: Return all numbers in [left,right] that are divisible by every nonzero digit they contain.
explanation: Inspect digits one by one; reject a number if a digit is zero or does not divide the number.

title: Flood Fill
statement: Starting at a pixel, recolor its four-directionally connected region of the original color.
explanation: Remember the starting color and visit only neighboring pixels with that color; avoid revisiting changed cells.

title: Find Smallest Letter Greater Than Target
statement: In a sorted character array, return the smallest character strictly greater than target, wrapping to the first character if necessary.
explanation: Binary-search for the first letter greater than target; if none exists, return the first letter.

title: Min Cost Climbing Stairs
statement: Given the cost of each stair, return the minimum cost to reach beyond the last stair when each move advances one or two steps.
explanation: For each step, combine its cost with the minimum cost to reach either of the two preceding steps.

title: Largest Number At Least Twice of Others
statement: Return the index of the largest value if it is at least twice every other value; otherwise return -1.
explanation: Find the largest and second-largest values, then compare them; a single-element array returns index zero.

title: Shortest Completing Word
statement: Return the shortest word containing all letters from a license plate, ignoring digits, spaces, and case.
explanation: Count required letters and select the shortest word whose letter counts cover each requirement.

title: Prime Number of Set Bits in Binary Representation
statement: Count integers in [left,right] whose binary representation contains a prime number of set bits.
explanation: Count set bits and check whether the count is prime; counts are small for the problem constraints.

title: Toeplitz Matrix
approach: Compare each cell with its upper-left neighbor
statement: Return true if every diagonal from top-left to bottom-right contains equal values.
explanation: Every cell outside the first row and first column must equal the cell immediately above and to the left.

title: Jewels and Stones
approach: Count stones present in jewel set
statement: Count how many characters in stones are also present in jewels.
explanation: Put jewel characters in a set and count each stone whose character belongs to it.

title: Minimum Distance Between BST Nodes
statement: Return the minimum absolute difference between values of any two distinct nodes in a BST.
explanation: Inorder traversal produces sorted values; the minimum difference occurs between adjacent values.
